name: coordination-prototype
description: Turns a collective decision into a catalogue of needs, binds arbitrary offers to them without a coordinator reading them, and shows the needs closing.

scripts.env: cp -n .env.example .env 2>/dev/null; node --env-file-if-exists=.env -e "const k=process.env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY||process.env.TYPESAFE_API_KEY||''; console.log(k ? '.env ready, key set ('+k.length+' chars) - left untouched' : '.env ready, no key set yet')"
